slides.title: Decided. *Then reopened.*
slides.sub: The choice you keep making again and again.

slides.title: Spot the loop
slides.body: Same question, same evidence, same answer. Then a week later you're weighing it all over again.

slides.title: Write the why, once
slides.body: One page. What you decided, why, and what you knew at the time. Plain words, no hedging.

slides.title: Reopen only for news
slides.body: Doubt isn't new information. A real change in the facts is. Know the difference.

slides.title: What's it costing you?
slides.body: Ask what keeping this decision open protects you from having to feel.
